record.reason: Primary abstract: Coding agents increasingly run inside organizations whose security controls (scoped credentials, restricted egress, read-only filesystems, non-root execution) constrain them like any other software. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate agents almost exclusiv Evaluates effects of security restrictions on coding agents; no inference-efficiency method.
record.title: Permission Denied: Policy-Graded Evaluation of Coding Agents in Hardened Environments
